picks.headline: AI model takes on the hardest part of forecasting: hurricane intensity
picks.title: AI model takes on the hardest part of forecasting: hurricane intensity
picks.excerpt: Artificial intelligence has revolutionized weather forecasting in just a few years, with global AI weather models now able to produce forecasts that rival some of the world's best physics-based prediction systems.
picks.rationale: Freshest pool item; AI tackling hurricane intensity (the weak spot of AI track forecasts), distinct from the earlier WeatherNext cyclone-track and general disaster-AI cards.

picks.headline: MD Anderson AI flags lung cancer patients at risk of immunotherapy side effect from routine imaging
picks.title: MD Anderson AI flags lung cancer patients at risk of immunotherapy side effect from routine imaging
picks.excerpt: Researchers at The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center have developed an artificial intelligence (AI) model that can identify lung cancer patients at increased risk of developing a serious immunotherapy-related side effect before treatment begins, offering a possible path toward more personalized monitoring a
picks.rationale: Clinical AI research with a concrete pre-treatment prediction from scans patients already get; new angle (immunotherapy toxicity) not covered by recent cancer-detection cards.

picks.headline: Machine learning finds chemicals that safely keep honey bees away from pesticide-treated crops
picks.title: Machine learning finds chemicals that safely keep honey bees away from pesticide-treated crops
picks.excerpt: In a win for pollinator conservation, researchers at the University of California, Riverside, have developed a machine learning-based method to identify chemical compounds that can safely repel honey bees from pesticide-treated crops. The research offers a potential solution to one of agriculture's most urgent ecologic
picks.rationale: Ecology/agriculture axis absent from recent cards; ML-driven chemical screening (UC Riverside) with a clear real-world conservation payoff.

picks.headline: AtomFlow: flow-matching AI predicts 3D reactant structures while conserving every atom
picks.title: AtomFlow: flow-matching AI predicts 3D reactant structures while conserving every atom
picks.excerpt: AtomFlow, a flow-matching model, predicts three-dimensional reactant structures from a product structure while conserving every atom, advancing AI retrosynthesis.
picks.rationale: Core AI-for-chemistry method advance (atom-conserving 3D retrosynthesis via flow matching); adds a chemistry axis distinct from recent materials and protein cards.

picks.headline: IonQ tests quantum generative models for change detection on real satellite radar
picks.title: IonQ tests quantum generative models for change detection on real satellite radar
picks.excerpt: IonQ researchers tested a quantum machine learning model (quantum generative model) for detecting changes in real satellite radar imagery.
picks.rationale: Quantum-ML research evaluated on real Earth-observation data rather than toy sets; brings a third outlet and a quantum x remote-sensing axis.
